bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to calculate effect sizes of associations between gendered attribute words (e.g., male/female names and pronouns) and target concepts like career, family, math, arts, and science within contextualized sentence representations.

Evaluated using the Mean Average Cosine similarity (MAC) metric, an extension of SEAT for multiclass settings, to measure biases across Jewish, Christian, and Muslim identities using specific religious lexicons.
